# ui::PushClipRoundedRect

Header: `winui/render/Renderer.hpp`.

A rectangular clip with rounded corners (a card or a tile whose picture follows its rounded edge). Paired with the same [PopClip](render-commands.md#struct-popclip) as every other clip.

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::Bitmap photo = ui::Bitmap::read("cover.jpg");
renderer.push_clip_rounded_rect(ui::Rect{0, 0, 240, 160}, 8.0f);
renderer.draw_image(photo, ui::Rect{0, 0, 240, 160}, ui::Stretch::UniformToFill);
renderer.pop_clip();
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bounds` | `Rect` |  | The rectangle, in DIPs. |
| `radius` | `float` | `0.0f` | The corner radius, in DIPs; 0 is a plain rect clip. |
